text.content:
SEATTLE · NOVEMBER 2026

Domains of the night

Color Zone Who rules
Gold Downtown, Capitol Hill, Seattle Center Prince Whitmore
Stone gray Beneath Pioneer Square The Moles (Thornquist)
Dark green Snohomish Valley Sheriff Montgomery
Steel blue Harbor Island and Elliott Bay The Hound (granted by the Sheriff)
Emerald green Bellevue and the Eastside Halloway
Rust red Everett Salt's (Anarchs)
No color, hatched Ballard, South Lake Union, Tacoma Nobody, or everybody

Marked locations: ① The Hangar · ② The Farm · ③ The Glass Gallery · ④ The Sealed Underground · ⑤ Market Street, Ballard · ⑥ Halloway Tower · ⑦ Gale Sentinel · ⑧ Pike Place · ⑨ Club Cinder · ⑩ Salt's Bar · ⑪ The Larchmont · ⑫ The Cedar Cemetery · ⑬ The Observatory · ⑭ Northline · ⑮ Colman Dock · ⑯ Terminal 86

In one corner, in pencil, in Hal's handwriting: “South Lake Union: no hunting. Cameras everywhere.”
